title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.44
summary: Increase the local HLS safety buffer and prevent transient stream failures from falsely turning healthy cameras red in Live View.
changes: Expand the default local HLS ring to 30 one-second segments and keep browser playback about eight seconds behind the live edge
Extend HLS recovery grace and retry budgets to reduce visible stream flapping during short network interruptions
Suppress camera-wide stream_error while another session for the same camera is healthy and make Live View traffic lights follow real playback state
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.44
description: Deeper Local-HLS buffering, calmer browser recovery, and false-red Live View status protection.
releaseNotes: 30-second Local-HLS ring with an eight-second live delay and playback-aware camera status indicators.
